svg.title: Three graphs on one key per cell: precision-against-oracle and recall, Hobbes beside CodeGraphContext and repowise
svg.text: Three graphs, one key per cell: precision-against-oracle and recall, never pooled
Filled blue dot = Hobbes; hollow orange square = CodeGraphContext 0.6.13; hollow orange diamond = repowise 0.49.0 — the same repo, commit, answer key,
matcher and poison check (ADR-101). The tools' numbers are at our grain (C-94, C-95) and host-run (C-96). Hover a marker for its fraction; the grey line spans the three.
recall, of in-repo oracle pairs at the cell's roots

svg.text: Read across a row, never down a column: each cell's recall is over its own roots or resolved sites (C-62), and a precision is a lower bound (contradictions mostly triage to
the oracle's grain, A-8). Every Hobbes marker on the precision axis sits at 100% except ajv, hono (one scip-typescript union-member shape) and quic-go (a 99.6% lower bound, 0
hobbes-wrong). The tools' contradictions are a lower bound on their precision exactly as ours is on ours; a 40-row random sample read by hand found tool-wrong 39, oracle-grain
1 after the converters' Java annotation-line defect (C-94) was repaired and the Java cells regraded. On repowise-bench's draws the key is ours, at site grain — not comparable
with their published table; syft is absent because RTA over it is killed by the kernel on this box.
Rendered from docs/oracle-cells/ by bench/oracle/report/render.py (ADR-102); the numbers are in tables.md.
